subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become the permanent public mechanism for plugins to own ephemeral per-run resources, or should browser ownership remain behind a narrower internal/runtime seam?
rationale: Both shapes can implement this bug fix, but selecting a permanent Plugin SDK ownership primitive is an external compatibility decision that code review and tests cannot make safely.

options.title: Approve opaque run context
options.body: Keep the optional documented `runId` field as the generic host-issued key for ephemeral plugin resource ownership, then require real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep ownership internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK field and inject browser cleanup ownership through a bundled-browser-specific runtime seam, avoiding a new external contract at the cost of a less reusable boundary.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle consolidation
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101830 to resolve the adjacent retirement path, then rebase and reassess whether one shared lifecycle primitive can cover both changes.

recommendation.title: Approve opaque run context
recommendation.body: Keep the optional documented `runId` field as the generic host-issued key for ephemeral plugin resource ownership, then require real browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate across agent runtime and published plugin boundaries.
